newsitem.title: CANADA: Golden Knight in C$74.25 mln placement.
newsitem.headline: Golden Knight in C$74.25 mln placement.

text.p: Golden Knight Resources Inc said on Tuesday it agreed to place C$74.25 million in special warrants with institutional investors and with Teck Corp, its biggest shareholder.
The placement will consist of nine million special warrants at C$8.25 a warrant. Teck will subscribe for 1.21 million warrants or C$10 million of the placement.

Golden Knight said Teck holds 35.4 percent of the company. The price represents a discount of about five percent to the closing price of Golden Knight stock on the Toronto Stock Exchange as of August 30.
Each warrant is exchangeable without additional payment into one Golden Knight share. The placement is subject to appropriate regulatory approval.
Nesbitt Burns Inc will lead the syndicate that will underwrite the issue.
